history: Found live in the verify page, whose parseReceipt recursed with no depth counter until V8 stopped it with an uncaught RangeError -- reachable by pasting a file, and stable from about 8,000 levels up. The same file had already learned this lesson once: 'pasting the literal null took the verify page down' is a comment in it. Now bounded at the same depth as the others.
note: 20,000 open brackets. Every implementation REFUSES -- with a diagnosis, not a stack trace. A crash is not a refusal: canonical.py catches CPython's RecursionError at this seam and re-raises it as a WireFormatError precisely because 'a verifier that crashes on hostile input has failed open in the eyes of whoever handed it the file'.
signature: browser=crash while both shipped parsers refuse
